name: mcp-instagram
description: Read Instagram profiles, posts, stories and comments, and like, comment and follow.
long_description: Unofficial Instagram integration built on instagram-private-api. Instagram may flag or restrict accounts used through unofficial APIs, so prefer a secondary account. Write actions (likes, comments, follows) are rate limited by the server. Your password is sent only in the login request and never written to disk; the session is saved privately in ~/.config/mcp-instagram (or %APPDATA%\mcp-instagram on Windows).

ig_username.title: Instagram username
ig_username.description: The account to log in with.

ig_password.title: Instagram password
ig_password.description: Used only for the login request. If the account uses two-factor authentication, you will be asked for the code in the conversation.
